entry.content:

The TVHS plugin for macOS and Windows emulates the physics of VHS decks and CRT televisions. It utilizes filtered noise for pitch drift and a Poisson process for random dropouts to prevent repetitive looping. The software also reproduces video-side artifacts, such as head-switching glitches and CRT flyback whine, using 10 convolution impulse responses.

The plugin includes 11 independently bypassable effects and 60 factory presets. It is compatible with VST, VST3, and AU formats and features native support for Apple Silicon. The software is priced at $49, with a 72-hour introductory price of $9.50.
